name: Data Slicing / Interval Set Rendering
aliases: Fast Volume Rendering of Data Slices
Real-time Data Slicing / Interval Set Rendering
definition: An algorithm for rapid selection and representation of scalar field data on regular grids, enabling fast cycling through data space by selecting and rendering specific value intervals.
summary: Data Slicing renders scalar field intervals by splatting pre-sorted points with constant color, eliminating the need for depth sorting.
